lead: Glass terrarium measuring 35x25x28 cm. Volume: 24.5 liters, horizontal format. A clean glass space with decorative film on the outside that helps the terrarium blend into your home. Handmade in Novi Sad.

description.html: At 35x25x28 cm and 24.5 liters, this terrarium offers a clean glass space with decorative film on the outside. The film is functional: it stops animals from seeing their reflection and reduces stress, while helping the terrarium blend into your home.

The horizontal layout with 35 cm of length gives a floor area where a basking zone, a cool zone and a hiding area are easy to arrange. This layout is key for reptiles because it lets them choose the temperature they are exposed to. The ventilation system with a protective mesh keeps fresh air flowing and prevents moisture buildup.

If the standard dimensions don't suit you, we build custom terrariums. Choose the size, film pattern, background style and extras such as LED lighting or a thermostat. Contact us for a quote. We deliver across Serbia.
